motivation: With fixedD2 the prior AE16/14/12 paths yielded74/64/24 successes out of80. This branch tests whether more Euler updates change the task preference of shallower action experts. Quality gains or complementarity are not assumed.

fixed_science.cycle: FullD10 then two configured Fast requests
fixed_science.residual_compensation: Unused because every VLM mask is empty. Periodic own-Full timestamps preserve the existing scheduling/receipt contract.
fixed_science.sampler: Unchanged Pi0Adapter.sample; original-adapter uniform EulerD2/D3/D4 and released fusedD10. Original sampler/kernel sources remain unchanged.

calibration.requirement: Original unwrapped adapter AE18 versus observed wrapper on D2/D3/D4/D10, raw/decoded1e-5; actual AE visits/NFE and exact Euler nodes; full VLM prefix/period/reset; reproduce all eight known Full/AE16 action/raw trajectories bitwise across both original roots.
calibration.cost: Six conditions,four old-bank suite inputs,6 warmup and12 measured requests each; completed three-request cycle cost, not layer-count equivalence

discovery.reuse: Original Full80 and AE16D2 80 have different directories/manifests. Preserve every source identity and alias only in derived analysis; these160 cells are not new replications.
discovery.selection: After all320 new and160 original cells accepted: both overall>=.75 and>=Full-.15; each completed-service median fixed-input cost ratio>=1.15; pair cost within10%; opposite distinct-suite gaps>=.10,>=2 positive tasks,each task LOO positive.
discovery.ranking: Maximum minimum directional count gap,sum gaps,minimum overall successes,then lexical path/suite ids. Freeze one pair only; discovery p-values remain descriptive.

confirmation.conditions: Full and exactly two frozen selected paths
confirmation.primary: One-sided exact ten-task signflip including ties; Holm2 across exactly two frozen directions
confirmation.bootstrap_arithmetic: Integer paired/task difference sums before division, preserving the exact zero boundary
confirmation.verdict: Both directions positive,primary Holm2p<.05,whole-task bootstrap lower>0,each task LOOpositive; both paths overall>=.75 and>=Full-.15; each cost ratio>=1.15 and pair within10%.

limits: Suite-conditioned periodic paths only; no universal semantic/phase/runtime-selection claim, no exclusive-GPU or closed-loop acceleration claim. Logical layer visits are not FLOPs or latency. Multiple exploratory branches do not imply study-wide5% error control.
no_candidate: Preserve all valid outcomes and do not lower gates or run confirmation. The bounded search ending does not complete the overall goal.
